subtitle: 退租後押金被不合理扣款，寫信向房東爭取
task: You moved out of an off-campus apartment last month. Your landlord, Mr. Patel, has kept NT$8,000 of your NT$20,000 deposit for cleaning and wall damage, but you believe most of these charges are unfair. Write an email to him. Explain why you disagree, give evidence, and propose a fair solution.
taskZh: 你上個月搬離校外租屋處。房東 Patel 先生以「清潔和牆面損壞」為由，從新台幣 20,000 元押金中扣了 8,000 元，但你認為大部分扣款不合理。寫一封 email 給他：說明你不同意的理由、提供證據，並提出公平的解決方案。
focus: 用證據逐點反駁（照片、檢查表）
承認合理的部分，提出具體的解決方案
正式用語與複雜句型（propose that … be …）

en: Thank you for returning part of my security deposit for the apartment at 12 Lane 45, Xinsheng Road. However, I was surprised to see that NT$8,000 had been deducted for cleaning and wall damage, and I would like to ask you to reconsider these charges.

First, regarding cleaning, I left the apartment in the same condition as when I moved in. I spent a full day cleaning the kitchen, bathroom, and floors before I returned the keys, and I took photos of every room that afternoon, which I have attached. As you can see, the apartment was clearly clean and ready for the next tenant.

Second, the marks on the bedroom wall were already there when I moved in two years ago. They are listed on the move-in checklist that we both signed on September 1, 2024, a copy of which is also attached. I do accept that the small hole I made when hanging a shelf is my responsibility, and I am willing to pay a reasonable amount to repair it.

I would therefore like to propose that NT$1,000 be kept for the shelf repair and that the remaining NT$7,000 be returned to me. If you disagree, I would appreciate a copy of the receipts for the cleaning and repair work so that I can understand how the amount was calculated.
I hope we can resolve this matter in a friendly way. I look forward to hearing from you within the next two weeks.
zh: 謝謝您退還新生路 45 巷 12 號公寓的部分押金。不過，我很驚訝看到押金被扣了新台幣 8,000 元的清潔費和牆面損壞費，想請您重新考慮這些費用。
首先，關於清潔，我退租時公寓的狀況和我搬進來時一樣。歸還鑰匙前，我花了一整天清理廚房、浴室和地板，當天下午也拍下了每個房間的照片，照片已附在信中。從照片可以看出，公寓明顯很乾淨，可以直接給下一位房客入住。
第二，臥室牆上的痕跡在我兩年前搬進來時就已經存在。這些痕跡都列在我們 2024 年 9 月 1 日共同簽署的入住檢查表上，影本也一併附上。我承認掛架子時打的小洞是我的責任，我願意支付合理的修補費用。
因此，我想提議保留新台幣 1,000 元作為架子的修補費，其餘的 7,000 元退還給我。如果您不同意，希望您能提供清潔和修繕的收據影本，讓我了解金額是怎麼計算的。
希望我們能友善地解決這件事。期待在兩週內收到您的回覆。
